scope: Corollary 1.2 (Quadratic transport–entropy inequality) of the manuscript “A dimension-free logarithmic Sobolev inequality for subgaussian log-concave measures” (preprints/A-dimension-free-logarithmic-Sobolev-inequality-for-subgaussian-log-concave-measures-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 093 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 767a5eb7cd819af7), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Under the assumptions of Theorem 1.1, every ν ∈ P2(Rn) satisfies W2(ν, µ)2 ≤ Ca2 H(ν | µ), with the same absolute constant C as in that theorem.
